groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Speech on the left: talking, reading, telling.

chars.story: Words aimed straight at the person who helped you: thank.
chars.note: Also 'decline politely' (谢绝) and, of flowers, 'wither'.

chars.story: Words handed over one by one, like goods across a counter: read them out.
chars.note: Also 'attend school' (就读). 讀: 言 became 讠 and 賣 became 卖.

chars.story: Words drawn up bucket after bucket from a well: he speaks at length.
chars.note: Also 'explain', and 讲究 'be particular about'.

chars.story: Words beside a fire stacked high, late into the night: a long talk.
Words with a sharp edge 斥 in them: complain, accuse.
chars.note: 告诉 'tell' is its commonest word; alone in the news, 'sue, complain'.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: something done with the hands.

chars.story: A hand flinging seed across the field 田 below: sow, then spread news: broadcast.
chars.note: The old sense is 'sow seed'.

chars.story: A hand comparing 比 one piece of work against another, marking the faults: criticize.
chars.note: Also 'approve' (批准) and a measure for batches: 一批货 'a batch of goods'.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 非 two rows
chars.story: A hand setting things in two facing rows, like the strokes of 非: a row.
chars.note: 排队 'line up'. Also 'push out, discharge' (排放).

chars.story: A hand bracing the pole as the sun clears the horizon 旦: carry the day's load.
chars.note: 担心 'worry': a heart carrying a load.

chars.story: A hand closed tight round a small pellet 丸: grasp it, then carry it out.
chars.note: Mostly 'grasp and carry out': 执行 a plan, 执法 'enforce the law'.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person on the left.

chars.story: A person bending right down to the base 氐, the dot beneath his feet: low.
chars.note: Lookalike: 底 'bottom' puts 氐 under a lean-to.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 𠂉 a stroke + 力 strength
chars.story: A person struck from above with force 力: injured.
chars.note: 伤心 'sad': a wounded heart.

chars.story: A person and the clothes he cannot do without: depend on.
chars.note: 依然 and 依旧 'still, as before' are common.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 丨 stick + 攵 tap + 彡 strokes
chars.story: A person tapping things straight with a stick, then adding fine brush strokes 彡: repair.
chars.note: Also 'build' (修建) and 'cultivate oneself' (修养).

chars.story: A person dressed in borrowed 叚 things: fake.
chars.note: Also 'holiday' (放假, 假期) and 'if' (假如).

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: anything wet.

chars.story: Water running on in one long channel: a river.
chars.note: 江 is a great river of the south; 河 is the general word.

chars.story: Water where the coastline bends 弯: a bay.
chars.note: 台湾 is Taiwan.

chars.story: Water checked against a marked rule 则: measure its depth.
Water splitting into branching streams 𠂢: one river, many factions.
chars.note: As a verb 'send, assign' (派出); 派对 is a 'party'.

groups.title: family
groups.note: Father, mother, husband, brother.

chars.story: A hand raising a rod: the father who rules the house.

chars.parts: - 女 woman with two dots for breasts
chars.story: A woman with two dots marking her breasts: mother.
chars.note: Also 'female' of animals.

chars.parts: - 大 a man with a pin across his head
chars.story: A grown man 大 with a pin through his topknot: husband.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'ah!', 夫 opening a sentence. Modern 夫 is 'husband, man'.

chars.story: One 可 standing on top of another: the brother above you, the elder brother.
chars.note: Also a friendly 'guy, bro': 帅哥 'handsome guy'.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth: speaking, calling, a hole.

chars.story: A mouth wide open, the cry twisting out 丩: call.
chars.note: 我叫… 'I am called…'. Also 'make, let', and 'by' in passives.

chars.story: A story passed through ten mouths, ten generations: ancient.
A mouth 口 under 不: it says no, or asks 'or not?'
A mouth 口 reading the divining crack 卜 and claiming the spot: occupy.
chars.note: Also 'make up' a share: 占一半 'make up half'.

groups.title: knife 刀 刂
groups.note: A knife, often squeezed to 刂 on the right.

chars.story: A fresh knife cut 刂 on the ridge 冈: it was done just now.
chars.note: The old sense 'hard, firm' survives in 刚强.

chars.story: A knife fight 刂 in someone's home 居, played out before an audience: theater.
chars.note: Also 'severe, sharp': 加剧 'intensify'.

chars.story: A knife 刂 cutting the case into halves 半: judge which side is right.
A knife cutting cloth for clothes: the first step of tailoring.
chars.note: 初一 is the first day of a lunar month.

groups.title: heart 心
groups.note: A heart underneath: wishes and thoughts.

chars.story: A scholar's 士 heart set on one thing: his ambition.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'aim', the same idea. In 杂志 and 标志 it is 'record, mark'.

chars.story: What is in your heart 心 right now 今: you remember.
chars.note: Also 'miss' (想念) and 'read aloud, study' (念书).

chars.story: A wish rising from the source 原 of the heart: willing.
chars.note: 願 had 頁 head on the right; now 原 sits on 心.

groups.title: numbers and amounts
groups.note: How many, how often.

chars.parts: - a lid on two spread legs
chars.story: A lid 亠 over two splayed legs: six.

chars.parts: 丷 parted + 二 two + 丨 a centre line
chars.story: A line drawn straight down the middle, the top split apart: half.
chars.note: 半天 also means 'a long while'.

chars.story: Two right hands 又 又 side by side: a pair.
chars.note: 雙 was two birds 隹 held in one hand.

chars.parts: - a rope 玄 with drops each side, over 十
chars.story: A rope pulled taut, the same drops falling on each side: a steady rate.
chars.note: Also 'lead' (率领) and 'frank' (坦率).

chars.story: Steps 步 back and forth in front of a head 页: again and again, frequent.
chars.note: In tech words, 'frequency, channel': 视频 'video', 音频 'audio'.

groups.title: overhangs 尸 广 厂
groups.note: A stroke across the top and down the left: a body, a lean-to, a cliff.

chars.story: A body 尸 settled down on something old 古: someone who has long resided here.
chars.note: 居然 'to one's surprise' is very common.

chars.story: Under 尸, clouds 云 stacked one on another: layers.
chars.note: Also 'floor, storey': 三层 'third floor'. 層: 曾 inside became 云.

chars.story: Under the lean-to 广, down at the base 氐: the bottom.
chars.note: 到底 'after all, on earth'. Lookalike 低 'low'.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 土 earth + 丶 dot
chars.story: Earth 土 crushed under a cliff 厂: pressure.
chars.note: As a verb 'press down'. 壓: 厭 over 土 shrank to 厂.

groups.title: names from abroad
groups.note: Used to spell foreign names and loanwords.

chars.parts: 区 region + 欠 open mouth
chars.story: A far-off region 区 people gape 欠 at: Europe.
chars.note: Short for 欧洲 'Europe'; also spells foreign names.

chars.story: Grass 艹 that gets back to work 办 after winter: revive.
chars.note: Mostly a name: 苏州 Suzhou, 苏联 the Soviet Union, the surname Su.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 匕 a kneeling figure
chars.story: A body 尸 bowed over a kneeling figure 匕: a Buddhist nun.
chars.note: Mostly it spells foreign names: 印尼 Indonesia, 尼泊尔 Nepal.

chars.story: Stuck between 上 above and 下 below: a card jammed in a slot.
chars.note: A loanword: 卡车 'truck', 卡通 'cartoon'. As a verb, 'get stuck'.

groups.title: mound 阝
groups.note: 阝 on the left is a mound or hillside.

chars.story: An earth bank 阝 raised on every side 方: prevent the flood.
A steep hillside 阝 that all 佥 must climb: dangerous.
The sun 日 falling on one face of the hill 阝: the sunny side.
chars.note: 太阳 is 'the sun'; the yang of yin and yang (阴阳). 陽: 昜 became 日.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Twisted silk on the left: thread, weaving, colour.

chars.story: Silk strands woven flat 扁: weave, then put together: compile.
chars.note: 编辑 'edit'. Also 'weave' and 'make up' a story (编故事).

chars.story: Silk worked 工 in the dye vat: red.
chars.note: Also 'popular' (走红) and 'revolutionary'.

chars.story: Silk threads tied to each 各 other: a small net, a mesh.
chars.note: Almost always in 网络 'network, internet'.

groups.title: roof 宀 and cave 穴
groups.note: A roof or a cave mouth on top.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 必 must + 山 mountain
chars.story: A roof 宀 deep among mountains 山, trees packed close: dense, hidden.
chars.note: Also 'secret' (秘密) and 'close' (密切).

chars.story: Under the roof 宀, where you arrive 至 and stop: a room.
chars.note: A room by function, in compounds: 教室 'classroom', 办公室 'office'; 房 is a room of a house.

chars.story: A dog 犬 bursting out of a cave 穴: sudden.
chars.note: Also 'stick out' (突出 'prominent').

groups.title: eye 目 罒
groups.note: An eye, upright 目 or lying flat 罒.

chars.story: An eye 目 beside 艮, a man turning to stare back: eye.
chars.note: Also 'a glance': 看一眼 'take a look'. The everyday word for 'eye'; 目 is the literary one.

chars.story: Under the net 罒, everything set straight 直: put in place.

chars.parts: 〢 + 𠂉 a figure bending + 皿 basin
chars.story: A figure bending over a basin 皿 of water, watching closely: supervise.
chars.note: 監 showed a man looking into a basin; the top is now strokes.

groups.title: moon 月
groups.note: 月 as moon, or as flesh.

chars.story: Two equal shapes side by side: friends.
chars.note: Modern Chinese uses it only in 朋友. Classical 'friend', as in 有朋自远方来.

chars.story: A cut of flesh 月 hacked off with a club 殳: one portion, a share.
chars.note: Also 'thigh' (屁股 'bottom') and a measure for smells and forces (一股).

chars.parts: 生 growing plant (top) + 月 (really 丹 red pigment)
chars.story: New shoots 生 above, fresh colour below: the green of young plants: youth.
chars.note: The colour is blue-green, of sky or grass; 绿 is plain green.

groups.title: seal 卩
groups.note: 卩 is a kneeling person, or a seal.

chars.parts: 亼 a roof + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: A man kneeling 卩 under the roof of authority: a command.
chars.note: 令人吃惊 'astonishing': it makes one surprised.

chars.story: A hand 𠂎 pressing a seal 卩 down: print.
chars.note: 印度 is India.

chars.parts: - 卩 a sentry standing on a line
chars.story: A sentry 卩 planted on his line, not moving: guard.
chars.note: 卫生间 is the toilet. 衛, with 行 'road' round it, shrank to 卫.

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Linking words for 'although', 'still', 'as far as possible'.

chars.story: Although it is only an insect 虫 with a mouth 口, it still bites.
chars.note: 虽然…但是… 'although…, (yet)…'. 雖 had 隹 bird on the right.

chars.story: A person who is then 乃 just as before: still.
chars.note: Formal 'still': 仍然; the spoken one is 还.

chars.story: Measured to the last mark of the ruler 尺, two drops left: to the utmost.
chars.note: 尽管 'although'. Also 'use up, end' (尽头 'the end').

groups.title: four left sides
groups.note: 礻 altar, 彳 step, 车 cart, 土 earth: you will meet them again.

chars.parts: 礻 altar + 畐 full jar
chars.story: At the altar 礻, a jar filled to the brim 畐: good fortune.
Steps 彳 up to the temple 寺, where guests are received: treat.
chars.note: Also 'wait' (等待) and 'stay' (待在家 'stay home').

chars.story: A cart 车 riding high, nothing in it: lightweight.
chars.note: 年轻 'young': light in years. 輕: 車 became 车.

chars.parts: 土 earth + 或 a guarded border
chars.story: Earth 土 marked off and guarded with a spear 或: a domain.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Pictures to learn as a whole.

chars.story: A foot planted flat on the ground: stop.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'foot'. Modern 止 is 'stop'; the foot survives only inside other characters.

chars.story: A single wing, its feathers flicking up: fly.
chars.note: 飛 lost its second wing.

chars.story: A ribbed horn tapering to a point: angle, corner.
chars.note: In 角色 and 主角 it is 'role'. Also 'horn', and a 10-cent coin.

chars.parts: - hands raised from below, holding up a figure
chars.story: Many hands raised from below, holding up the load: undertake.
chars.note: 承认 'admit' is its commonest word.

chars.parts: - a lid 人 over a bowl of food 良
chars.story: A lid set over a full bowl: food.
chars.note: As a left side it shrinks to 饣 (饭, 饿).

chars.parts: - a figure slipping out from under a hat
chars.story: A figure 儿 slipping out from under a heavy hat: escape, avoid.
chars.note: Lookalike 兔 'rabbit' has a tail dot.

groups.title: walls 囗
groups.note: A box round the outside: an enclosure.

chars.story: A wall 囗 running all the way round: surround.
Ground walled in 囗 for planting: garden, park.
chars.note: 園: 袁 inside became 元.

groups.title: shell 贝
groups.note: Shells were money: 贝 means valuables.

chars.story: A person ⺈ with money 贝 on his back: bear a load, and a debt.
chars.note: Also 'lose' (胜负 'win or lose') and 'negative' in maths.

chars.story: Shells 贝 gathered by talent 才: wealth.

groups.title: bamboo ⺮
groups.note: Bamboo on top: slips for writing, sticks, tubes.

chars.story: Bamboo slips with gaps 间 between: short writing, simple.
chars.note: The old 'bamboo slip' for writing. 簡: 門 became 门.

chars.story: A bamboo whip with thorns 朿 to drive the horse on: a plan, a policy.

groups.title: stone 石
groups.note: A rock under a cliff.

chars.parts: - a rock 口 under a cliff 丆
chars.story: A rock 口 fallen under the cliff edge: stone.
A stone 石 striking skin 皮: torn, broken.
chars.note: Also 'shabby' (破衣服 'ragged clothes').

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: The walking road along the bottom.

chars.story: Walking 辶 with someone as far as the pass 关: send him off.
chars.note: Also 'see off' and 'deliver' (送货).

chars.story: Walking 辶 along, the taste on your tongue 舌 just right: it suits you.
chars.note: 適: 啇 on the walk became 舌. His Analects card: 'go to'; modern 适 is 'suit, fit'.

groups.title: bed 丬
groups.note: 丬 is a bed stood on end.

chars.story: A dog 犬 stretched out by its bed 丬: you can see its shape and condition.
chars.note: Also 'written complaint' (告状).

chars.parts: 丬 bed + 夕 evening + 大 big
chars.story: At the evening 夕 feast, the big 大 winner reclines on his couch 丬: prize.

groups.title: field 田
groups.note: A field, or anything ruled in squares.

chars.parts: 卯 open gates + 田 field
chars.story: The gates 卯 left open at the field 田: the farmer stays on, the crop remains.
chars.note: Also 'leave' a message (留言) and 'keep'.

chars.parts: - a field 田 in a frame 凵, a line on top
chars.story: A field 田 drawn inside a frame 凵, a ruled line above: a painting.
chars.note: Also 'draw'. 畫 had 聿 brush on top; the brush is gone.

groups.title: tree 木 and grain 禾
groups.note: A tree, or a grain stalk with a drooping head.

chars.story: A few trees 木 and an inch 寸 of land: a village.
Grain 禾 stacked up, one bundle at a time: accumulate.
chars.note: 积极 'positive, active' is very common. 積: 責 became 只.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 洛 (氵 water + 各) (sound)
chars.story: Leaves 艹 dropping into the water 氵, each 各 in turn: fall.
chars.note: Also 'set' of the sun, and 'settle': 落实 'put into effect'.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 氵 water + 㔾 kneeling figure
chars.story: A figure kneeling 㔾 by the water, pressing clay into a mould: a pattern.
chars.note: 范围 'scope, range' is its commonest word. Also a surname. 範 had 竹 and 車.

groups.title: sun 日
groups.note: The sun, inside or beside.

chars.story: The sun 日 slipping away 免: evening.
chars.note: Also 'late' (太晚了 'too late').

chars.parts: 並 side by side + 日 sun
chars.story: The sun 日 shining on everything side by side 並: general, universal.

groups.title: cloth 巾
groups.note: 巾 is a hanging cloth.

chars.story: A band of people 邦 under one cloth banner 巾: they help each other.
chars.note: Also 'gang' (帮派). 幫: 封 over 帛 became 邦 over 巾.

chars.parts: 广 shelter + 廿 + 巾 cloth
chars.story: A cloth 巾 mat spread under the shelter 广: your place to sit.
chars.note: Mostly 'seat, place' at a meeting: 主席 'chairman', 出席 'attend'.

sentences.en: I have no friends to help me.
The treaty was not a success.
This food does not agree with me.
I'd like to attend the party.

sentences.zh: 我跟父母讲了留学的事情。
sentences.en: I talked with my parents about my studying abroad.

sentences.zh: 人造卫星从河内上空飞过。
sentences.en: The satellite came flying over Hanoi.

sentences.zh: 我不想承担这样一个风险。
sentences.en: I don't want to take such a risk.

sentences.zh: 亚美尼亚语是一门印欧语言。
虽然我承认你说的,但是我仍然认为你是错的。
sentences.en: Admitting what you say, I still think you are in the wrong.

sentences.zh: 中国政府控制了网络，以免让人民知道六四事件的真相。
sentences.en: The Chinese government controlled the internet to prevent the people from knowing the truth of the Tiananmen Square Massacre.
